response.text: Dominion Energy South Carolina is currently progressing the Hooks - Thurmond 115kV Tie: Rebuild project to address end of life and reliability issues across approximately 2.3 miles, targeting an in-service date of 2024-12-31. Located 4.09 miles away, Georgia (GPC) has planned the Evans Primary - Thurmond Dam (USA) #5 115kV Rebuild to rebuild approximately 5.45 miles of line, with a build start date of 2029-06-01 and an in-service date of 2033-06-01. The project windows do not overlap, leaving a time gap of 3074 days with sequential timing and a medium shared level. Shared items between these rebuild efforts include surveys, right-of-way records, environmental studies, and design of the later project.
